QuestInfo.name: [Yeti & Pepe] Who's Leading Who?
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9000292##k says he has a good idea.
QuestInfo.1: You and the 'shroom schemed a plan to ride Yeti. Talk to #b#p9000292##k and then go find Yeti and Pepe.
QuestInfo.2: You heard the truth about the relationship between Yeti and Pepe.

0.0: We're down to our last option. Something far more bold. Daring.
0.1: Only a famous hero can pull this one off. If you do well, I will describe all your amazing help in my book, and you can be even MORE famous! Sounds like a pretty good deal, right?
0.2: The plan is to ride on a Yeti ourselves! When the Yeti is getting ready for the day, just pretend to be Pepe. Don't worry, I'll give you a Pepe Metamorph Potion. I worked so hard on this, so you HAVE to make this work.
0.3: Now, shall we proceed with the plan?

yes.0: Now, tell me if you're ready. You, not Pepe, will be THE rider of El Nath!

no.0: I think my plan is splendid... Don't you think we should give it a shot?
